briefing.headline: xAI and DeepSeek release multimodal frontier models, intensifying open-weight competition

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI race accelerates with new model releases from xAI and DeepSeek. Compute demand surges while regulatory scrutiny grows in the US and EU. Prompt injection and multi-agent security remain critical gaps.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: xAI unveiled Grok-3 with native video reasoning; DeepSeek-V3 matches GPT-4o performance on coding benchmarks. Meta open-sourced Llama-4 405B weights under new commercial license.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level, with new automotive CAN bus pilots reported this week.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC begins volume production of 2nm AI chips; Microsoft announces $4B expansion of its Arizona data center cluster. Google TPU v6 pods reach 100k-chip scale.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will open-weight models close the capability gap with closed frontier labs by end of 2027?
